entries.embedded_english: We're surrounded!
(on radio)  Heads down into the sand, 2nd Division.   This is the California - you have incoming artillery support, courtesy the US Navy.
Fall back marines! We don't wanna be here when those shells hit.
Awww mannnn
Miller, grab that bazooka and buy us some time, fire on those goddamn tanks.
Enemy to the left side
Keep firing.  Make every bullet count.
There goes our light.  Now the fun really starts!
Get to cover!
Stay sharp, Sniper! In the trees ahead.
Enemy at the right flank
MG's! Take cover!
Nearly, sir.  Gimme a couple more minutes.  (pause, to himself as he fiddles with the radio controls)  C'mon...C'mon...
Enemy mortars took out most of our men
That looks like the last of them.  Good work, men.
Keep down and wait for more star shells.
I see 'em.  They're in those mortar  shell craters!
Watch out.  Spider holes!
Whooeee! Good shooting, Miller.
Heads up, enemy grenades from above.
Hold the line!
Marine, make the call to the California, we need naval support. Now!
Quick!  Open fire - before they run back into cover!
Miller - grab that bazooka, hope to hell there's still a shell in it, and use it on that bunker.
What now Sarge?
Some of em made it through into the bunker
Man! They just keep on coming.
Hell, they're everywhere!
Our boys are down there...  Looks like they could do with some help.   Back 'em up, Marines!
Landing site's just over these dunes, sarge.
Miller, you're with me, the rest of you, topside.
Keep on moving through the bunker! We need to reach the line.
They're cutting us to pieces, sarge!  How much longer we gotta hold on?
We can't hold 'em back for much longer.
We gotta take out that MG bunker, run to cover and try to get in close
Sarge, Miller, this way, we've got positions at the line, but we need more men.

Listen up, Marines.  We're out of position.  From here, we need to head north, to the main landing site.  Just sit tight - we only go when the star shells are deployed. Marine!  What's happening with that radio!?
Now Polonsky? We take that mountain…
Ah hell, they'e got tanks.  Enemy armor, on the horizon!
Miller get on that MG
Enemy on the east flank, Sarge!..
On the double - get to that trench!
Mines in the water!  Keep away from the shoreline!
Okay, keep to cover, flank the bunker from the right side.
They're excecuting our men!   That ain't no way for a Marine to die.  Get in there and save what's left of our guys!

Better get ready, guys.  Looks like the Japanese have launched one hell of  a counter-attack, and they're going to be coming right through here.  We need to hold this position, or they'll push us right back off this island.
The mortar fire finally slacked off, but those goddamn MGs have got the whole beach covered and we can't get near 'em.
